'''Gladiopods''' were a part-crustacean, part-reptilian carnivorous [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the shadow world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. The species had long spiked legs and multi-tentacled faces with four glowing red eyes on each side. Gladiopods lived in groups, fulfilling roles of either soldiers or workers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gladiopods were added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' with patch 5.4 that introduced Umbara to the game. They appear as enemies during the "Crisis on Umbara" flashpoint.
